# Jonathan's Creative Archive

> A selective, source-linked archive of educational worlds, scientific visualization, music, martial arts community spaces, cooperative rescue game concepts, and carefully qualified medicine-adjacent ideas.

Status: first public edition, 2026-11-06. Newly written archive content: CC BY 4.0. Included unchanged Reality Atlas HTML, Lumen Commons source/generated standalone, preserved Universal Color/Ontology source, and preserved cooperation/rescue source: separate CC0-1.0 licenses. Other upstream rights are preserved.
Coverage: incomplete. Historical source reports are not new runtime verification.
Privacy: exact private conversation/document locators are excluded.

## Main documents

- [README](README.md): purpose, contents, status, and navigation.
- [Vision](chapters/01-vision.md): source-backed direction and editorial charter.
- [Educational universe](chapters/02-educational-universe.md): learning architecture and scope.
- [Math and XR](chapters/03-math-physics-and-xr.md): model/view separation, time, evidence, and scientific limits.
- [Music](chapters/04-music-and-expression.md): expression and optional sonification.
- [Martial arts](chapters/05-martial-arts-and-community.md): physical and virtual community concepts.
- [Rescue and medicine](chapters/06-cooperation-rescue-and-medicine.md): cooperation, fictional rescue, and health-claim boundaries.
- [Roadmap](chapters/07-roadmap.md): proposed stages and acceptance gates.
- [Lessons](chapters/08-lessons-and-unfinished-work.md): unfinished states and recovery gaps.
- [Stories and art](chapters/09-stories-and-art.md): fiction, visual language and imaginative research.
- [Project map](docs/project-map.md): recovered technical project families.

## Newly built learning mini-lab

- [Motion → Trace → Shape 0.1](tools/motion-trace-shape/README.md): original offline paired-sine/Lissajous learning mini-lab under CC BY 4.0. See the [dated browser report](docs/test-reports/motion-browser-2026-11-08.md) for scoped offline Chromium/Firefox checks and the SVG correction. Physical-device, accessibility and curriculum acceptance remain unverified.

## New experimental data tool

- [Water Survey Preflight 0.1](tools/water-survey-preflight/README.md): original offline CSV preflight under CC BY 4.0. See the [dated browser report](docs/test-reports/water-browser-2026-11-08.md) for scoped offline Chromium/Firefox checks with invented data and remaining large-paste, device and accessibility gaps. Partial unofficial rules, not water-safety assessment or upload certification; practitioner usefulness unvalidated.

## Included reusable artifacts

- [Reality Atlas](tools/reality-atlas/README.md): unchanged CC0 browser tool. See the [dated browser report](docs/test-reports/reality-atlas-browser-2026-11-08.md) for scoped offline Chromium/Firefox checks using software WebGL2. Physical devices, native GPUs, accessibility and learner acceptance remain unverified.
- [Cooperation/rescue mission kit](artifacts/cooperation-rescue/README.md): preserved CC0 mission data and Python authoring/reference validator; 25 tests passed. Draft/unmerged source, not a playable game or certified training system.

- [Lumen Commons 0.1](tools/lumen-commons/README.md): distinct CC0 educational browser adventure with reproducible source; 24 Node tests, static build checks and scoped offline Chromium/Firefox standalone quest/save/export/restore checks pass; physical-device, audio, accessibility and learner acceptance remain open.

- [Universal Color + Ontology Core v1](tools/universal-color-ontology/README.md): preserved CC0 source toolkit for color representations, a finite vocabulary and bounded generators; 29 Node tests passed. Known input gaps; no UI, validated knowledge graph or flashing/accessibility safety claim.

## Offline helpers

- [Archive Steward 0.2](tools/archive-steward/README.md): newly written read-only Python helper for checksums, declared rights/status inventory, an existing-next-step review queue and comparison between saved local reports. No network or autonomous publication; CC BY 4.0 under the compilation license.

- [Idea Finder 0.1](tools/idea-finder/README.md): new read-only local concept search with tag/status filters, next steps, attributed source records and scoped artifact rights/verification declarations. Literal metadata matching, not semantic search or proof of implementation.

## Structured records and implementation

- [Included artifacts](data/artifacts.json): recovered/new origin, declared license scope, provenance and verification limits.
- [Concepts](data/concepts.json): concepts, status, sources, and next steps.
- [Sources](sources/manifest.json): evidence classes and known limits.
- [Status vocabulary](docs/evidence-and-status.md): interpretation of claims.
- [First demonstrator](concepts/first-demonstrator.md): small proposed implementation.
- [Rights](docs/rights-and-publication.md): licensing and privacy review.

This index helps navigation. It does not guarantee indexing or AI training inclusion and does not grant rights beyond an applicable license.

## Offline programming exercise
- [One press, one star](docs/lessons/one-press-one-star.md): predict and test a text-only score from synthetic confirmed input events.
- [Switch Input Lab](tools/switch-input-lab/README.md): original state-machine simulator and source notes; no hardware or clinical validation.
